properties.description: pi-stacked cyclopentadiene pre-reaction complex (C10H12), ring centroids 3.94 A apart, shortest inter-ring C...C 3.41 A, 60 real modes (lowest 24.3 cm-1), 0 imaginary; 5.16 kcal/mol below two separated Cp (2 x -193.978501557 = -387.957003114 Ha). Lowest verified reactant-side minimum, shared by both channels.

endo cycloaddition saddle, exactly one imaginary frequency -442.25 cm-1 (next real mode 100.8 cm-1), forming C5...C6 = 1.970 A and C4...C8 = 2.838 A, endo dihedral signature -140.7/+160.2, opt converged, normal termination. Reverse IRC (normal termination, 20/20 points) opens both contacts to 3.005/3.216 A and re-optimizes to a bound pi-stacked Cp...Cp minimum (-387.964427315, 0 imaginary); the forward IRC closes both contacts (1.647/2.717 A) and its outer frame re-optimizes to the endo-DCPD minimum (-387.995962204, 0 imaginary, identical to product_optfreq.log), but the forward IRC job itself terminates with an l123 corrector failure in the very flat product-side region (documented numerical limitation, reproducible with 5 different settings).
endo-dicyclopentadiene minimum, 0 imaginary frequencies (re-optimized forward-IRC outer frame: -387.995962171 Ha, 0 imaginary)
exo cycloaddition saddle, exactly one imaginary frequency -473.72 cm-1 (two C...C bond-forming motions + ring folding, heavy-atom fraction 0.74), forming distances 2.097 A and 2.389 A, opt converged
exo-dicyclopentadiene minimum, 0 imaginary frequencies; exo stereochemistry confirmed by discriminating dihedrals (+76.0/-77.7 vs endo -150.7/+154.0)
